title: task_refute — the box refuter's result on one ralph-v2 Task (docs/plans/ralph-v2 C5)
description: Written by task_refute, and by task_refute_fb on the hosted fallback. task_review_gate applies the evidence rule and the disputes; the reviewer decides nothing. _io is stamped by the server.

summary.description: One or two sentences: the verdict, and what was left unchecked.

edge_cases.description: One entry per edge case in plan.json; [] when there is none.

id.description: The edge case's id from plan.json.

covered.description: true when a test in this Task's change would fail if the case broke.

evidence.description: The path:N of that test, or what you searched for and did not find.

findings.description: Every finding you can prove; [] when there is none.

severity.description: error: the Task must not pass with it. warning: worth fixing while the Task is open.

kind.description: not_met: a goal or acceptance statement does not hold. defect: the change introduces wrong behaviour.

file.description: Repository-relative path of an existing file.

line.description: The most relevant line in `file`, or null.

message.description: What is wrong, the concrete impact, and the outcome the code must reach. Written for someone who has not seen the diff.

evidence.description: What proves it: a path:N that exists, or a command in backticks with its result. The gate drops a finding without one.

class.description: The class of input or state this is one example of; an empty string when it is a single case.

repeat_of.description: The id of the earlier finding in history.md this repeats, or null.

responses.description: Exactly one entry per disputed finding that is yours; [] when there is none.

finding_id.description: The id of a disputed finding listed in history.md.

verdict.description: withdrawn: the dispute is right. upheld: it is wrong, and new_evidence shows why.

new_evidence.description: For upheld: a path:N or a command in backticks that the finding did not cite before. An empty string for withdrawn.
